title: Is MATLAB Free for Students? Campus Licence, MATLAB Online and Student Price (2026)
summary: MATLAB is free if your college has a Campus-Wide Licence; otherwise MATLAB Online gives 20 free hours a month and the Student Suite costs USD 49/year in India.
body_markdown:
## How much does MATLAB Student cost in India?


The[MathWorks India store](https://in.mathworks.com/store/link/products/student/new) lists the **MATLAB and Simulink Student Suite at USD 49.00** (excluding taxes), noting that "the product pricing applies for purchase and use in India". Extra toolboxes cost **USD 13.00** each. The store shows the price in US dollars only, so your card is charged the rupee equivalent on the day plus tax.


The Suite includes MATLAB, Simulink and 13 add-ons: Control System, Curve Fitting, Deep Learning, DSP System, Image Processing, Optimization, Parallel Computing, Signal Processing, Statistics and Machine Learning and Symbolic Math toolboxes, plus Simscape, Simscape Electrical and the Online Training Suite. There is no cheaper MATLAB-only student product in the store.


**Annual, not lifetime.** The store sells it as an annual licence ("right to use the software for a 12-month period"). Older guides that talk about a one-time student purchase describe an offer that has been replaced.

## Who can buy MATLAB Student, and can you use it after graduation?


MathWorks sells student licences "for use in conjunction with courses offered at a degree-granting institution", so you must be enrolled. The student licence is for your coursework and learning, not for paid or company work. After you graduate, or for an internship, the employer's licence or a commercial licence applies. Check the licence agreement shown at checkout for the exact terms.


## What are the MATLAB system requirements?


MATLAB is one of the few engineering tools that runs on all three operating systems. For R2026b:


Windows macOS Linux


Versions Windows 11, Windows 10 (22H2) macOS 15, 26, 27 on **Apple silicon only** Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04, Debian 12/13, RHEL 8/9/10, SLES 15


RAM 8 GB min, **16 GB recommended** 8 GB min, 16 GB recommended 8 GB min, 16 GB recommended


Disk (MATLAB only / typical) 4.6 GB / 5-8 GB 3.7 GB / 4-6 GB 4.5 GB / 5-7 GB


Note for older MacBooks: MathWorks says "MATLAB is no longer available for Macs with Intel processors". Intel Mac owners should use MATLAB Online. GPU computing in MATLAB needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU. Our[laptop guide for engineering students](https://resources.skill-lync.com/articles/best-laptop-for-engineering-students-india/) compares hardware for MATLAB and heavier CAD/CAE tools.


## Is GNU Octave a good free alternative to MATLAB?


For learning the language and running course scripts, often yes.[GNU Octave](https://octave.org/) is free under the GPL, runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and its syntax is "largely compatible with Matlab". The latest release is Octave 11.3.0 (June 2026). The catch: **Simulink and most toolboxes have no Octave equivalent** , and some functions behave differently. If your course or internship uses Simulink (controls, EV powertrains, battery models), you need real MATLAB.


## Which option should you pick?


- **Your college has a campus licence:** use it. Full MATLAB, free, on your own laptop.
- **No campus licence, light use:** MATLAB Online basic plus Onramp covers first- and second-year labs.
- **Final-year project or Simulink work:** use the 30-day trial for a short project, or buy the USD 49 Student Suite for a year.
- **Just want to practise maths scripts:** Octave is free and fine.


## How to learn MATLAB for engineering


MATLAB pays off when you use it on engineering problems: solving ODEs for a spring-mass system, post-processing test data, building a Simulink model of a vehicle or a motor controller.
